## Function Validate Record

Turns a parsed record document into a typed Contour Record, or every problem it has.

Behaviour: validateRecord(doc: unknown). A doc that is not a plain object (null, an array, a scalar) → {ok: false, problems: ["(root): a record must be an object"]}. Otherwise every object is checked against its key table (root: version, System, Actor, Requirement, Guardrail; System: name, description, requirements, guardrails, groups; Component: name, description, language, requirements, guardrails, functions, dataObjects, interfaces; Function: name, description, behavior, requirements, guardrails, preconditions, steps, examples; example: given, when, then, ref; Data Object: name, description, schema; Interface: name, description, exposes; Actor: name, description, uses; Requirement and Guardrail: name, description; P19: System gains dependencies after groups, Component gains uses after guardrails, a dependency: name, version, language, doc). Per object, in this order: each required key that is missing ("<path>.<key>: required"), each key not in the table in the object's own order ("<path>: unknown key '<k>' (known: <the table joined by ', '>)"), then the present keys' values in the table's order, depth first. Required: the root's System; every name and description; System.groups; a Function's behavior and examples; an example's given, when, then; an Interface's exposes. version, when present, must be 1 ("version: must be 1"); absent means 1. Texts must be non-empty strings and are stored trimmed; lists must be lists; list items that are elements must be objects; examples and exposes must not be empty; a step is an object with exactly one key, a verb of calls, reads, modifies, produces, uses, whose value is a non-empty string. A schema is a string, or a mapping of non-empty strings stored as JSON.stringify(mapping, null, 2). A Component name repeated in the record, a Function name repeated in its Component and a Data Object name repeated anywhere in the record is a problem at the repeat's name. Absent lists become [], absent language, ref and schema become null. Dependencies (P19): System.dependencies is a list of objects, each requiring name, version and language (texts, trimmed; doc an optional text, null when absent); a name repeated → "<path>.name: duplicate dependency name '<n>'"; a version (trimmed) not matching /^v?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*([-+][0-9A-Za-z.+-]+)?$/ → "<path>.version: must be an exact version (got '<v>')" (no range, tag or wildcard). Component.uses is a list; per item in order: not a non-empty string → "<path>[i]: must be a non-empty string"; its trimmed text not among the declared names → "<path>[i]: unknown dependency '<n>' (declared: <names joined by ', ', or none>)"; a name already listed before it → "<path>[i]: dependency '<n>' repeated". The declared names are read from the document before the groups are walked: the trimmed name of every item of System.dependencies that is an object with a non-empty string name, distinct, in order. Absent dependencies and uses become []. Whether a dependency's language fits the Component is the planner's check (the Component's language may come from the map). Any problem → {ok: false, problems} (all of them, document order); none → {ok: true, record}. The paths read System.groups[0].functions[3].examples[0].then; the root is "(root)".

- reads: Contour Record
- produces: Record Result

## Function Cut Units

The Functions and map groups of one Component as card units, in record order.

Behaviour: cutUnits(component, groups). A group none of whose Functions belongs to the Component is skipped (it is another Component's); a group naming some of its Functions and some it does not have → {ok: false, error: "group '<g>' names unknown Function '<first unknown>' next to '<first known>' of Component '<c>': a group names the Functions of one Component"}. Then, per Function in record order: not in a group → {id: slugName(its name), name: its name, functions: [it], isGroup: false}; in a group not placed yet → {id: slugName(the group's name), name: the group's name, functions: the group's Functions in record order, isGroup: true}, placed where its first Function stands. → {ok: true, units}.

Steps:
- reads: Contour Map
- produces: Unit

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

Behaviour: planSpec({record, map, spec, components, judge, hasFile}). Faults in this order: the map's language → Resolve Profile(null, map.language), unknown → "the map: <its error>"; Select Components(record, components) error. docs = map.docs without the spec path. Cut Component per selected Component in order (its error is the result), then, P19, its dependencies (componentDependencies, record order): the first with a doc that hasFile denies → "dependency '<name>' of Component '<component>': doc file not found: <doc>". Across cuts: a card whose slice the map did not set gets the first target of every dependsOn entry naming a cut card of another Component appended (when absent). Extra cards in map order: component null → kept; a component no Component of the record has by name or slug → "extra card '<customId>' names Component '<component>' the record does not have (have: <the record's Component names joined by ', '>)"; kept when it names a selected Component, else skipped; as Card {customId, intent or "patch", targets, contextSlice or [], instruction, acceptance, model, maxTokens (null when unset), reasoning: {maxTokens: reasoningMaxTokens} or null, variants or 1, dependsOn or []}, Cut Card {component null, profile null, functions [], slicedByMap true}. When judge: Cut Judges over every Cut Card (defaultProfile = the map's profile, typescript when unset), appended. P19: for every card Cut Component made whose Component has dependencies, in card order: uses[<its customId>] = their names (record order); their docs (not null, distinct, record order) are appended, each when absent, to its contextSlice and to the slice of the card "<customId>-judge" when there is one — also when the map set the slice, as a new list (the map's own list is never changed); extra cards get none. Every card's contextSlice loses every entry equal to spec (the record never rides in a slice). The first customId repeated in card order → "duplicate customId '<id>'". Order Deck (its error is the result). → {ok: true, plan: {spec, components: the selected names, cards, generations, externalDependsOn}, uses} (uses {} with no dependency; Plan keeps its five keys, so the plan document and the deck of a dependency-free record are byte for byte what they were). On the same record and map the old `mrph plan --spec --judge` gives the same ids, dependsOn and generations (golden cross-check; texts and targets differ by design).

Steps:
- calls: Cut Component
- calls: Cut Judges
- calls: Order Deck
- uses: contour
- produces: Plan

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

Callee Cut Component: The code cards of one Component, overrides applied, with what its judges need.
Behaviour: cutComponent({record, component, map, docs, spec}). Faults, each the result as soon as found, in this order: the profile = Resolve Profile(component.language, map.language), unknown → "Component '<name>': <its error>"; P19: the Component's dependencies = componentDependencies(record, component), the entries of record.system.dependencies whose name component.uses holds, in record order (exported from src/planner/cut.ts); the first whose language is not the profile's id, exactly → "Component '<name>' uses '<dep name>', a <dep language> dependency (the Component is <profile id>)"; Function Links errors → the first one; Cut Units(component, map.groups) error; a unit name without words → Name Targets' error; an Interface exposing a name no Function of the Component has → "Interface '<i>' exposes unknown Function '<f>'"; two base cards with one id → "duplicate customId '<id>'". Base cards: one per unit, targets [code, test] of Name Targets(profile, component.name, unit.name), deps = for each Function of the unit and each of its calls steps in order, the unit owning the callee when it is another unit, distinct; budget Card Budget codeBudget(the units' steps counted, its Functions counted, isGroup, its examples counted). Then per Interface in record order: exposing one Function → folded into that Function's card (its section follows the Function sections); exposing several → a base card of its own after the units, id slugName(its name), targets of Name Targets(profile, component.name, its name), deps the owners of the exposed Functions in exposes order, distinct, budget codeBudget(0, 1, false, 0), no Functions. Overrides: the map card whose id is the base id. Final id = its customId or the base id; targets = its targets or the base targets. dependsOn = its dependsOn, else the deps, each base id replaced by its final id (a name of no card of this cut kept as given). contextSlice = its contextSlice, else docs followed by the first target of every dependsOn entry that is a card of this cut (not yet present), and when that is empty the card's first target. instruction = the blocks preamble(docs, spec), Function sections, Interface sections (modules = the first final target of the card owning each exposed Function), the inherited section unless "", "Write the files: `<t1>`, `<t2>`." (each target in backticks, joined by ", "), Dependency Finale(profile, the Component's dependencies) — the profile's finale itself when there is none — joined by "\n\n"; an override's instruction replaces the first block. Card = {customId, intent: override or "patch", targets, contextSlice, instruction, acceptance: override or Acceptance Script(profile, customId, targets), model: override or null, maxTokens: override or the budget's, reasoning: {maxTokens: override reasoningMaxTokens or 2500}, variants: override or the budget's, dependsOn}. → {ok: true, cuts}, one Cut Card per card in base order: {card, component, profile, functions: the unit's Functions ([] for an Interface card), slicedByMap: the override set contextSlice}.

Default target: the profile's judgeTarget filled with {component: the base name of code[0]'s directory, name: code[0]'s base name without its extension}. dependsOn = [the card's id] then the override's dependsOn not yet present. test = testTarget(profile, targets) or targets[0].
